name: microsoft-outlook
description: Use when reading or triaging Outlook mail files (.msg, .eml, winmail.dat/TNEF, .ics, .pst), checking for phishing, extracting attachments safely, reading invites and time zones, or automating Outlook with Microsoft Graph, Office.js, rules, signatures and AQS/KQL search. Drafts only: never sends mail itself.

platforms.inspect_mail.py, extract_attachments.py,: any OS with Python 3.9+, standard library only (tested on Linux only)

tested_on_box: .msg fixture cross-read by olefile 0.47 and extract-msg 0.56.1
tnef.py vs tnefparse 1.4.0 on its 19 sample files
readpst 0.6.76 runs inside the documented bwrap command (no real .pst)
rtfbody.py vs compressed_rtf 1.0.7 on random and repetitive data
addins.md OnMessageSend example type-checked with TypeScript 5.9.3 --strict against @types/office-js 1.0.611
documented_not_executed: references/graph.md, calendar.md, rules-signatures.md, search.md (Microsoft Learn and Support, read 2026-10-13)

safety.writes: extract_attachments.py only, into a new folder
